title: Diet & Nutrition
shortDescription: Choose a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins.
modalDescription: Eating a balanced diet provides essential nutrients, boosts your immune system, and reduces the risk of chronic diseases such as diabetes and hypertension.

title: Physical Activity & Exercise
shortDescription: Engage in regular physical activity to maintain a healthy weight and strengthen your heart.
modalDescription: Aim for at least 150 minutes of moderate aerobic activity per week. Regular exercise improves mental health, mood, and sleep quality.

title: Hygiene & Prevention
shortDescription: Wash your hands regularly with soap and clean water for at least 20 seconds.
modalDescription: Handwashing is one of the most effective ways to prevent the spread of germs and avoid getting sick or spreading germs to others.

title: Avoid Harmful Habits
shortDescription: Limit or avoid alcohol and do not smoke to reduce serious health risks.
modalDescription: Avoiding tobacco and minimizing alcohol intake lowers your risk for heart disease, liver disease, and many forms of cancer.

title: Rest & Recovery
shortDescription: Prioritize quality sleep by maintaining a consistent schedule.
modalDescription: Most adults need 7–9 hours of sleep per night. Good sleep improves cognitive function, emotional resilience, and overall cardiovascular health.

title: Hydration
shortDescription: Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water throughout the day.
modalDescription: Water keeps every system in the body functioning properly. It aids digestion, regulates body temperature, and prevents dehydration headaches.
